name: tsa_redeemOrder
description: Marks an order redeemed. Refuses, with a user-facing message, when the token is unknown, the order belongs to another restaurant, it was already redeemed, or its date is not today's UTC date. @restaurantId comes from the restaurant portal session cookie. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'redeemOrder' to [TSA].[tsa_redeemOrder]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: QR code token to redeem. No default.

parameters.name: restaurantId
parameters.description: Restaurant redeeming (from its session). No default; a NULL silently skips the ownership check.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: One row: success, one of four refusals (lines 36, 43, 50, 57) or CATCH (line 70).

columns.name: Success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 on refusal or error.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; 'Order not found.' | 'This order is not for your restaurant.' | 'This order has already been redeemed.' | 'This order has expired.' | ERROR_MESSAGE().

codeSmells.detail: @token, @restaurantId (lines 2-3) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.
The CATCH (lines 68-71) returns the error envelope but writes nothing to HC.ErrorLog or any TSA log table, so failures are only visible in Azure Function logs as a 400 warning.

codeSmells.issue: NULL restaurantId bypasses the ownership check
codeSmells.detail: Line 40 tests @orderRestaurantId <> @restaurantId; with @restaurantId NULL the comparison is UNKNOWN and the order is redeemed for any restaurant. The shim maps an empty GET query value to NULL and needs no key for GET, so GET ?queryType=redeemOrder&token=<t>&restaurantId= redeems any order. Use ISNULL/NOT EXISTS, and require @restaurantId.
Line 54 compares the order date with CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS DATE). In the US the UTC date changes at 19:00-20:00 local, so a lunch-to-evening order presented after that hour is refused as 'expired'.

The read at lines 26-31 takes no UPDLOCK; two concurrent scans of one QR both see redeemedAt NULL and both return Success = 1. Add WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) or make the UPDATE conditional on redeemedAt IS NULL and check @@ROWCOUNT.
Header (line 13) says Success SMALLINT; the literal is INT.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
